main_text.p: Mauritium & Chaganum, inter Abaros & inter Romanos. Infimulauit enim ruptæ pacis Romanos,[illegible, ~2 letters] nec sine caufa. Etenim reuera pacis adulteri cum fuerint, autoresq; belli in ea quæ diximus ma-la inciderunt. Dirimit Romanos Ifter ab Abaris, veluti sequefter; vltra verò, si quis fluuium transmittat, Sclauorum ditio est. sed & adiectæ funtau-ri Chiliades viginti ad inducias, vnde bellum inter Abaros & Romanos finitum.

Quod eodem circiter tempore Chosroes molitus est pacem frangere, ista de caufa. Saraceno-rum quidam militabant in auxiliis Romanis,& eo-rum vnus sponte sua Perfiam inuadens[illegible, ~3 letters] pacis tempore, excursione ista partes aliquot Babyloniæ infeftauerat. qua de re quo ea animo fieret aut in quâ partem accipienda essent, cum dubitaret Chosroes, Mauritius in Perfida mittit Legatum Georgium, qui vrbium Orientalium tributis præfectus erat, vel vt Romani vocant præfectus Prætorio. Atgra-uiter ferens iniuriam illatam sibi Chosroes, reli-ctum legatum dies in barbara regione distinuit.[illegible, ~3 letters] Itaque Georgius per multos dies detinetur, introi-tu in regiam nondum potitus, postea turbidis Chos-roæ rebus, bonum visum est barbaro, ne tum bel-lum contra Romanos ingereret: sic Georgius in regiam receptus à rege Babylonio, cum præsentis tum temporis statum fauentem haberet, perfuadet barbarum ne pacis pacta transiliret. eo igitur modo Chosroes volens nolens pacem amplectitur. Legatus autem omnia quæ & quomodo acciderant ple-nè fu-

page.notes: The right margin is cut off at the scan edge; only fragments of its notes are visible (for example "ei", "ius", "cu", "pr", "Ch", "fa"), which I could not read reliably, so the marginal notes are shown as illegible placeholders at their approximate positions. The running head's final letters are cropped, so "SIMOCATTÆ" is doubtful. "distinuit" is printed as "diftinuit" in the scan, and I have kept the printed spelling. The paragraph ends on "fu-" and continues on the next page.
